versions.text: There is no prohibition on account of chamets on Passover except [from] the five species of grain alone; and they are the two species of wheat - being wheat and spelt; and the three species of barley - being barley, oats, and rye. But legumes, like rice, millet, beans, lentils and that which is similar to them, are not [prohibited] on account of chamets. Rather even if one kneaded rice flour and the like in boiling water and covered it in clothes until it rose like leavened dough - it is surely permitted for eating, as this is not leavening but rather decay.
